questions_and_answers.question_text: What does the construction fare + infinitive express in this lesson?

answers.answer_text: To be able to do something

questions_and_answers.question_text: What often happens to fare when it is used in the infinitive form in the dialog?
How can qualcosa da fare be translated?

answers.answer_text: Something to do or something to be done

questions_and_answers.question_text: What does queste quattro camicie sono da lavare mean?

answers.answer_text: These four shirts need to be washed
These four shirts are too expensive
These four shirts have been sold

questions_and_answers.question_text: Why is di required in the second dialog examples mentioned in the notes?

answers.answer_text: Because the speaker is talking about a spot of something
Because all indirect objects require di

questions_and_answers.question_text: Why is tutto preceded by il in dialog two?

answers.answer_text: Because it refers to a specific amount of things
Because it refers only to people

questions_and_answers.question_text: What can servire mean besides "to serve"?
What does the indirect object Le indicate in I pomodori Le servono per ... ?

answers.answer_text: The person who is in need

questions_and_answers.question_text: What meaning does troppo have before a descriptive word?
Which pattern expresses the idea of "to remember ..." in these notes?
